historical_independence: NONE_PREVIOUSLY_SEEN; all lab outputs and AI feedback are contaminated development evidence
engine: research.phase2_v2.engine.evaluate; PRODUCTION target interface, frozen evaluator unchanged
venue: historical_spot_proxy; quote_volume includes documented base_volume_times_close proxies
derivatives: UNAVAILABLE; no funding, OI, liquidation or order-book inference; missing is never zero

breakout.definition: completed close exceeds prior threshold-day maximum high

mean_reversion.definition: close is threshold rolling 20-day standard deviations below 20-day mean

vol_compression.definition: 10-day / 60-day return volatility below threshold, positive 5-day momentum

vol_expansion.definition: 10-day / 60-day return volatility above threshold, positive 5-day momentum

volume_reaction.definition: spot quote-volume or declared proxy exceeds threshold times prior 30-day mean; close above open

relative_strength.definition: 30-day asset momentum minus BTC momentum exceeds threshold; BTC momentum nonnegative

rotation_churn.definition: at least threshold historical target rotations in prior 14 completed bars and negative held-asset 5-day momentum

take_profit_context.definition: canonical model asset exceeds rolling 20-day mean by threshold standard deviations; test 50 percent target reduction

stop_trail_context.definition: canonical model asset falls threshold below prior 20-day high; test exit context, no fabricated intrabar stop

reentry_confirmation.definition: positive 3-day rebound above threshold following negative previous 10-day momentum

publication_status: Unknown exact historical source publication times; one additional completed daily bar is frozen before next-open fill. Conservative proxy, not venue certification.
clustering: transitive union of trigger intervals [day, day+horizon] across ALL assets; one earliest event and rank/lexical asset per cluster; missing eligible days break clusters; cluster starts are causal
frequency: raw asset-day triggers separately from global independent clusters; denominators observed eligible asset-days and eligible calendar days only; event/year rate calendar exposure excludes missing days; zero/rare event remains INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
null: no positive conditional event/control forward-return difference; common calendar block sign symmetry conditional on magnitudes; a model assumption, not certified for historical prices
multiplicity: lifetime alpha spending 0.05/[t*(t+1)] for EVERY reserved comparison; all candidate/train/neighbor attempts increment immutable t before results; union bound requires conditionally valid p-values; block randomization handles within-block serial and cross-asset dependence; development diagnostics cannot certify a trading candidate
serial_uncertainty: calendar moving-block bootstrap on exposure/count pairs for frequency and on block event/control differences for association; 95 percent intervals; not IID row resampling

training.inner_selection: first chronological half screens; second half ranks; only prior-origin data; validation must have positive excess log growth and sufficient events; freeze before test

selection: one winner per family by inner-validation excess log growth over control, then lower MDD then normalized hypothesis ID; no outer feedback reselection at same origin
neighbors: all adjacent declared threshold values AND adjacent horizon; rerun same validation folds before test; require nonnegative validation excess growth for every neighbor
handoff: append-only structured hypotheses plus valid Phase2 J/M/N gene suggestions in isolated outbox; ingress validates prior-training cutoff for a future origin; never mutate or resume completed frozen v2 cycle
confirmed_trading_candidate: FORBIDDEN without separately authorized untouched prospective evaluation
stop: persist finite budget and all trials across cycles; after 14 processed origins report EXHAUSTED and leave timers enabled for unattended health checks without new API calls
